comparison.objective: Replace and align a razor blade under closed butterfly doors, unlike tuning a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Edge-only precision grasping, post alignment, seating, and door closure; candidate uses a hex key, cylindrical counterhold, collar adjustment, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: New blade sits on posts under closed doors and is released; explicit alignment tolerances, edge-contact detection, and damage criteria are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests hazardous thin-part handling and keyed seating, not dynamic calibration, despite shared fine alignment.
